headline: As of 2026-09-23: 117,518 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 8 of 50 states, D+32.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 117,518 early/mail ballots cast so far across 8 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+32.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (94,284), Wisconsin (9,654), North Carolina (8,280).
